description: LogLens attack signature database. Each rule is a regular expression matched against a decoded request path or the User-Agent. 'severity' is one of: critical, high, medium, low.

signatures.name: SQL injection - tautology
signatures.description: Classic ' OR 1=1 style payload that makes a WHERE clause always true.

signatures.name: SQL injection - UNION SELECT
signatures.description: Attempts to append a second result set to the original query.

signatures.name: SQL injection - stacked query
signatures.description: A semicolon followed by a destructive SQL keyword.

signatures.name: SQL injection - time based
signatures.description: Blind injection that proves itself by delaying the database.

signatures.name: Cross-site scripting - javascript: URI
signatures.description: A javascript: pseudo-protocol in a link or redirect parameter.

signatures.name: Path traversal - dot-dot-slash
signatures.description: Climbing out of the web root with ../ or ..\ .

signatures.name: Path traversal - sensitive file
signatures.description: Direct request for an operating-system file.

signatures.name: Path traversal - double encoded
signatures.description: Double URL encoding, used to slip past naive filters.

signatures.name: Scripted client
signatures.description: Command-line HTTP client - suspicious for a normal visitor.

signatures.name: Sensitive file probe
signatures.description: Requests for secrets or backup files that should never be web-accessible.

signatures.name: Command injection
signatures.description: Shell metacharacters chained to a system command.

brute_force.description: N or more failed authentication responses from one IP inside the window.
